name: Galaxy A54 5G

images.credit: Hajoon0102, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Predecessor: Samsung Galaxy A53 5G, Samsung Galaxy A73 5G
Launch.Successor: Samsung Galaxy A55 5G , Samsung Galaxy A35 5G (US only)

Network.SIM: Dual nano SIM or Nano-SIM and eSIM, (varies by carrier and international models)

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 13 with One UI 5.1, Current: Android 17 with One UI 9.0

Display.Display: 6.4 in, Infinity-O display, Super AMOLED, 120Hz refresh rate, 1000 nits (HBM), 1080 x 2340 px resolution, 19.5:9 aspect ratio (~403 ppi density)

Cameras.Front camera: Sony IMX 616; 32 Megapixel, MP, f/2.2, 25mm (wide), FoV 82.5°, 1/2.74", 0.8µm, Camera features: HDR, Video recording: 4K resolution, 4K@30fps, 1080p@30/60fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax 2.4G-5GHz, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot, Bluetooth 5.3, A2DP, LE, A-GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS
